job_final_validation.scope: fresh session, exact identity comparison, online authorization GET for authenticated source and conditional final HEAD/local stat; no atomic collection snapshot

admission.execution: serial synchronous delivery; no next decoder while writer retains a tile
admission.source_scope: source budget includes decoder, encoded-range retention, prepared metadata/coordinates, authentication and checkpoint index/write scratch
admission.scope: working reservations; excludes allocator, TLS/HTTP runtime, OS/filesystem cache and caller-owned inputs; process RSS measured separately

output_io.scope: Zarr library operations and bytes, including coordinates and metadata; excludes final root metadata/manifest and publication synchronization; not device traffic

completion.final_source_validation: serial fresh-session sweep after all observations are written and individually validated, before final root metadata/manifest and publication synchronization
completion.source_snapshot: individually validated versions; not an atomic snapshot of a changing collection
completion.publication: existing checked atomic no-replace sibling rename on macOS/Linux
completion.restart: new staging and complete scientific reconstruction; reauthenticate every source; reuse verified source bytes only; no append, partial-output recovery or exactly-once processing
completion.synchronization: file handles synchronized before close, bottom-up directories, pre-rename device request, no-replace rename, parent synchronization and post-rename device request; process-interruption safety tested; power-loss durability unproven

processing: five raw typed variables; exact selected x/y coordinates; source time and attributes
five separate source masks and a derived quality_mask; distinct aoi_mask for geographic selections only; analysis_mask = aoi_mask & source_valid_wse & quality_mask
independent native grids in manifest order; no calibration, alignment, resampling or mosaic

post_publication_receipt.scope: returned CLI/API receipt; dataset manifest records all pre-publication work
